spike_swarm_sim.actuators.RF_transmitter module¶

class spike_swarm_sim.actuators.RF_transmitter.RF_Transmitter(*args, range=10, msg_length=1, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: spike_swarm_sim.actuators.base_actuator.Actuator

Communication transmitter actuator. It isotropically transmits a frame with a message and its context. The propagation simulation is implemented at the receiver side, this class only updates the transmitted frame of each robot. ========================================================================= - Params:

range [float] : maximum distance of message reception, in centimeters. msg_length [int] : number of components of the message. quantize [bool] : whether to quantize the message to a set of possible

symbols or not.

step(action)[source]¶
